valueText.description:
The flattened, locale-formatted text (including prefix/suffix). Use for `aria-label`
or anywhere a plain string is needed.

announcedValueText.description:
The text to render inside `getValueTextProps()`. Same as `valueText`, except it only
updates once the roll animation settles - so a fast counter doesn't spam assistive tech.

segments.description:
The ordered segments of the formatted value - one per rolling digit, plus the symbols
between them (group separators, currency symbols, signs, literals).

digitCells.description:
The cells to render inside every digit track, in order. Map over this to build a digit's
strip - the same array is shared by every digit, and is stable across renders.

digitGlyphs.description:
The locale digit glyphs `0-9`, in order. An escape hatch for rendering digits outside a
digit track - `digitCells` already carries the glyph for each cell.

animating.description: Whether a roll animation is currently in progress. Reads a ref - does not subscribe.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the number-flow. Useful for composition.

value.description: The controlled numeric value to render.

defaultValue.description: The initial value to render when uncontrolled.

onValueChange.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

formatOptions.description: The options to pass to the `Intl.NumberFormat` constructor.

prefix.description: A static string rendered before the formatted value. Does not animate.

suffix.description: A static string rendered after the formatted value. Does not animate.

trend.description:
Controls the roll direction of each digit.
- `false` (default): each digit takes its own shortest path (`9 -> 0` rolls forward one step).
- `true`: every digit rolls in the direction of the overall value change.
- `1` / `-1`: force every digit to roll up or down, regardless of the value change.

continuous.description: Whether digits spin through every intermediate value instead of taking the nearest path.

spinTiming.description: The timing of the per-digit roll transition.

transformTiming.description: The timing of layout transitions - segments entering/exiting.

stagger.description: A CSS `<time>` delay applied between adjacent digits, e.g. `"25ms"`.

respectMotionPreference.description: Whether to suppress the roll animation when the user prefers reduced motion.

live.description:
Whether the value is announced to assistive technology as it changes.
When `false`, the rendered value is still readable, but changes are not announced.

onAnimationStart.description: Callback fired when a value change starts a roll animation.

onAnimationComplete.description: Callback fired when the roll animation settles.

locale.description: The current locale. Based on the BCP 47 definition.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.
